assumptions: repair-relevant distinction may be coarser than cause label
passive nonidentifiability is measured before policy comparison
falsifier: No decision/repair utility residual over strongest greedy/non-greedy parent after full cost, or false-confident/wrong-repair/label-leakage hard gate fails.
minimal_counterexamples: two causes only jointly distinguishable by two-feature acquisition
different causes imply same safe repair
costly acquisition improves label but not decision
novelty_residual: Decision-relevant non-greedy active diagnosis beyond greedy InfoMax and passive classification.
object_description: Decision-oriented active diagnosis that may acquire jointly informative measurements/interventions, with observational-equivalence lower bounds and abstention.
oracle_or_lower_bound: Enumerate observational equivalence under all admissible acquisitions; finite-horizon Bayes-optimal policy on small worlds provides oracle decision risk. If required repairs are indistinguishable under all actions, unique diagnosis is impossible in that scope.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped diagnosis/acquisition/repair utility only; no scientific causal authority.
qoi: Correct bounded repair / downstream decision utility per total acquisition+intervention+repair cost versus strongest greedy and non-greedy acquisition parents, with wrong-repair harm hard-gated.
same_system_ablation: Same failure worlds with greedy InfoMax, non-greedy ACO-style acquisition, stochastic AFA, abstain-only, and oracle decision policy.

strongest_parents.justification: incumbent greedy information-gain parent with known condition-dependent guarantees
non-greedy parent targeting jointly informative acquisitions
non-myopic parent reasoning over possible unobserved realizations

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = acquisition_policy + measurements + interventions + inference + repair + verification + registered_harm_loss
